strategies.build_shove4: Slow Push until the own front holds 20 HP, then Shove it into the tower; Pressure while sieging.
strategies.farm4: Last Hit and Hold position: farm the lane, never push by power.
strategies.freeze4: Freeze keeper: Thin every turn at the farm spot (Last Hit unless the enemy wave is the stronger).
strategies.freeze_recall4: Freeze keeper that Recalls while the freeze holds the enemy wave next to its tower.
strategies.grow_crash_recall4: Slow Push -> Last Hit -> Shove, then walk back and Recall while the crash occupies the enemy.
strategies.grow_shove4: Slow Push -> Last Hit -> Shove: nudge until ahead, let the lead grow, Shove at 20 HP; Pressure while sieging.
strategies.recall_at6: Last Hit; a scheduled Recall at turn 6.
strategies.shove4: Shove every turn (full capacity); Pressure while sieging.
strategies.slowpush4: Slow Push every turn: build a 1-HP window-strength lead and let it compound; Pressure while sieging.
strategies.sp_then_shove4: Slow Push for 10 turns, then Shove (adapts once a gradual push is neutralized).
strategies.thin4: Thin every turn and Hold position: last-hit, correct an enemy surplus (keeps a freeze).
strategies.thin_last4: Thin while the enemy blob is the larger, else Last Hit (explicit).
strategies.walk_up4: Walk up and last-hit (Hold position, Last Hit).
